answer_1.quote: Video-guided Machine Translation (VMT) is an emerging subtask of multimodal translation that has attracted growing research interest.
answer_1.outputs: translated sentences from source language (e.g., English) to target language (e.g., Chinese)

answer_2.quote: We adopt BLEU, COMET and BLEURT as automatic evaluation metrics to assess translation quality, aligning with current standards in LLM-based translation research.

answer_4.quote: We also randomly selected 50 outputs from each test set generated by Qwen2.5-VL-7B and MiniCPM-V 2.6 using either the SHIFT framework or direct video-text input for human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluators were computer science PhD students who are native Chinese speakers with strong bilingual proficiency. We provided the annotators with fair compensation based on the local wage standards.
